item.title: Woman charged with using vehicle as weapon in St. Lucie County assault
item.description:
Tioniea Hines, 22, sits in St. Lucie County Jail on $75,000 bond after authorities charged her with three counts of aggravated battery with a deadly weapon. Investigators say Hines used her vehicle to assault three people.

item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday in a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Czech's Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon after wasting five match points
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to win Wimbledon on Saturday.
